carts.title: jumpy
carts.author: adv
carts.about: four worlds to run, jump and stomp through! springs, checkpoints, slimes, bats and three new songs.

carts.title: road rush
carts.author: adv
carts.about: dodge the traffic, grab the fuel, drive on to the desert, the city at night and the snow!

carts.title: bug storm
carts.author: adv
carts.about: shoot the bugs before they swoop! power-ups, and a boss every 5 waves. arrows fly, z fires.

carts.title: zap rally
carts.author: adv
carts.about: pong! first to 7 wins. z: play against adv. x: 2 players (player 2 uses w/s).

carts.title: flapjack
carts.author: adv
carts.about: tap z or up to flap between the pipes. it gets faster the further you go!

carts.title: cloud hopper
carts.author: adv
carts.about: bounce on springs, climb vines, dodge the bats! made with the game kit, with no code at all.

carts.title: echo pads
carts.author: adv
carts.about: watch the pads light up, then copy them with the arrows. one more every round!

carts.title: smashbox
carts.author: adv
carts.about: smash every brick with the bouncing ball! 5 lives and a nice wide paddle.

carts.title: hello adv
carts.author: adv
carts.about: the very first adv cart. a bouncy ball and the whole palette.

carts.title: creators-game
carts.author: Atomicdude
carts.about: This is my first game im atomicdude you can call me atomic and i created ADV!!

carts.title: noodle
carts.author: adv
carts.about: eat the apples, grow, don't crash! golden apples are worth 3. z: 1 player, x: 2 (player 2 uses w a s d).

carts.title: space rubble
carts.author: adv
carts.about: blast the rocks before they get you! left/right turn, up thrusts, z fires, down is hyperspace. watch out for the ufo!

carts.title: lava lode
carts.author: adv
carts.about: a long cave of coins, slimes, bats, springs and a ladder. made with the game kit: no code!
